title: Discord channels reorganized and support moved to Mihulish
summary: The channel list was tidied up, five older channels were archived, and Mihulish now helps members find answers and open private support requests.
description: On November 8, TheySix reordered the Discord channel list and archived five channels. Members can use the wiki, /faq, and Mihulish modmail for current guidance and help.

body.text: Channels were reordered to make community discussions, updates, downloads, and support easier to find. Five older channels moved to the archived category, including addons, guide, and two FAQ channels.

Use /faq for common questions, /rules for community guidelines, and the TheySix Wiki for detailed guides. DM Mihulish to choose a support type and answer its questions; the bot then creates a private channel for you and staff.
Use /dn or the farm archive to find a farm by Download Number. World files and Java schematics remain in their respective download channels.
